title: A Prom for the Detention
author: Sebastian Whitlock
blurb: Elodie Zhou, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
